SymptomMeaningLikely causeFix
401 / invalid signatureSeal mismatchDifferent secret / changed body / pathMatch keys; check method/path/query
401 / replay detectedTicket already usedRetried request; file store multi-hostFresh nonce; shared replayStore

422 / decrypt failedLocked envelope won't openAEAD key / AAD / bindHeaders mismatchMatch keys & bindHeaders

FAQ

Rejected even with correct keys?

Normalized path differs, query order, or a proxy mutated the body. Align canonicalization.

Safe behind a load balancer?

Yes, with a shared replayStore (Redis/Memcached) and requireReplayStore.

Without encryption?

Yes — mode hmac. The body stays readable.

Is response always HMAC?

No. Response follows signAlg (HMAC, server Ed25519, or hybrid).

Default replayTtl / clockSkew?

120 and 60 seconds.

Use X-Canonical-Request to verify?

No. Debug only.

Upgrade v3 → v4?

Match version on both sides; see CHANGELOG for multipart wire.

Safe debugging?

CLI debug:verify and test:roundtrip — never print secrets.

Hybrid without pqSigner?

It fails closed. Provide an app implementation.

Small file vs stream?

In-memory ≈ ≤10MB; streaming for large files.

Is PSR-16 always atomic?

No. Prefer caches with atomic add().

Audited?

No third-party audit yet.
